say:1:1620564001:1.text: I'll admit, you handled that faster than I expected. Maybe I've underestimated your kind.
say:1:1620564001:1.source_cn: 不得不说，你做事的效率的确让我对犬科动物的态度，有所改观。
say:1:1620564001:1.male: I'll admit, you handled that faster than I expected. Maybe I've underestimated your kind.
say:1:1620564001:1.female: I'll admit, you handled that faster than I expected. Maybe I've underestimated your kind.

say:2:1620564002:1.text: And since I'm a cat of my word, your reward's right there at your feet. I prepared it in advance.
say:2:1620564002:1.source_cn: 既然如此我也不会食言，奖励就在你脚边，我早就为你准备好了。
